rootCause: Firestore read-only store relation-scoped logicalRows resolved policy/client relations with Array.find for every row and every relational constraint. Receipt/portfolio/payment collections therefore multiplied scans across 1419 policies and 439 clients; Cliente360 clientesResumenIndex inherited this cost.
fix: Build policyById/clientById relation maps once per relation-filter invocation.
Resolve __relation_country__/advisor/team in O(1) map lookups rather than repeated linear Array.find scans.
Preserve the same query-plan semantics and read-only boundary.
Bump the store asset cache key so Preview loads the indexed implementation.
